scope: Repeated alternating run-level on/off pairs, matched authored identity/compiled capacity/seeds/event admission. Independent timing distributions, not frame-paired subtraction or statistical significance. Outer render graph, not whole app/game. Public physical native buffer sizes/no resize-warning gate and public asynchronous native index-demand acknowledgments, not paired with timing/buffer frames. Private Z-slice demand/allocations/staging and in-flight memory remain unmeasured. One GPU/headless target/default layers, not finale certification.

method.build: optimized development build, Windows; sequential native subprocesses, no concurrent GPU/build workloads
method.selection_fixture: Existing explicit 1500-lumen/12m/per-output-cap32 light fixture; normal materials/events/trails/transforms unchanged
method.representative_flashes: show only; independent high-tier cap8, same both modes
method.timings: Outer render graph CPU/GPU and independent phase distributions. Run-level mean subtraction only, no frame pairing, percentile sums, statistical-significance or whole-app budget claim.
method.validation: Strict B1 resource gates and thirteen-clip show admission/cleanup gates (8413 accepted per run), matched stable paths/sources/seeds/capacities/event totals, all eighteen native exits zero, reports/logs/binary/asset hashes, public-buffer and asynchronous-demand gates
method.validator_repair: The complete second aligned matrix initially hit a validator parser error on a composition root's null event-link observations. The parser now preserves null rather than manufacturing zero/empty data, with a regression self-test. All eighteen unchanged raw reports passed read-only revalidation; summary/accepted manifest were finalized after that pass, without rerunning or substituting timings.

qualification.actual_public_buffers: Each measured view index list 2097152 bytes, offsets/counts 117504 bytes, grid 17x9x24; global clustered-light storage measured once. Z-slice buffer inaccessible through public module exports.
qualification.counter_origin: Public main-world Clusters.last_frame_total_cluster_index_count is an asynchronous native acknowledgment. Repeated/stale counts are possible, not paired with render buffer or timing observations.
qualification.exclusions: Private Z-slice/scratchpad/metadata/staging, old in-flight allocations, creation/allocator churn, textures and allocator overhead unmeasured. No total-memory or hard overflow/finale budget certification.
qualification.logs: No native resize/corruption/error/panic log gate failures in accepted runs. Headless/shutdown warnings are not suppressed; closed-channel readback warnings may remain. A separate abnormal native exit is retained as a failed attempt, not certified fixed.
qualification.follow_up: Show cleanup retains substantial async index demand despite zero writable selected capacity. Main-world zero-lumen placeholders retain max-range; their injection is skipped once no selected frame is prepared. This is a source-backed hypothesis for idle cluster work, not a paired causal measurement. Target inactive-slot transitions plus private/in-flight allocation/overflow instrumentation next.

failed_grid_attempt.finding: All 18 native processes completed, but measured show offsets/counts sizes oscillated2304/117504 bytes. Index list stayed2097152 bytes; no resize warnings. Gate rejected this attempt.
failed_grid_attempt.explanation: Bevy0.19.1 defaults adaptive index target16384 independently of GPU initial capacity. The benchmark had increased the latter to524288 without aligning the former. Native assign_objects_to_clusters shrinks XY from asynchronous demand; the aligned rerun removed observed size/grid changes. Original attempt has no public-demand telemetry; source-backed explanation, not frame-paired causal proof.

failed_native_attempt.finding: Nine successful entries, then tenth native process wrote its report but exited0xc0000409 (STATUS_STACK_BUFFER_OVERRUN). Log contains closed readback-channel shutdown warnings, which alone do not establish the crash cause. Incomplete attempt stays unaccepted; no report from it contributes accepted cost rows.
